product_summary: Orbit Lifescience Pvt Ltd (Orbit Group, launched 2004; 7th Floor Mehta Mahal, 15 Matthew Road, Opera House, Mumbai 400004; directors Arvind Sheth, Amit Sheth, Ashish Sheth) presents itself as an API + finished-formulation house with a stated portfolio of 'more than 300 products' across FMCG/OTC, Generics, Biologicals and Novel formulations. The API page lists a very large, therapy-class-organised catalogue: SERMs (Bazedoxifene HCl/acetate, Raloxifene HCl), antiretrovirals (Atazanavir, Tenofovir, Sofosbuvir, Valacyclovir, Valganciclovir), antibiotics (Cefdinir, Cefixime, Ceftriaxone sodium sterile, Cefuroxime axetil, Ciprofloxacin HCl, Enrofloxacin, Ertapenem, Imipenem, Meropenem, Rifaximin, Vancomycin, Moxifloxacin HCl, Cefpodoxime proxetil, Sulbactam sodium sterile), NSAIDs/analgesics (Paracetamol, Nimesulide, Aceclofenac, Celecoxib, Etoricoxib, Etodolac, Mefenamic acid, Tapentadol, Pregabalin, Thiocolchicoside), CNS (Zolpidem tartrate, Bupropion HCl, Levomilnacipran, Gabapentin, Levetiracetam, Vigabatrin, Citicoline sodium, Homotaurine, Brexpiprazole, Safinamide), antidiabetics (Metformin, Glipizide, Gliclazide, Teneligliptin, Voglibose), statins (Atorvastatin, Rosuvastatin), PPIs (Rabeprazole sodium), antimalarials/antiprotozoals (Ornidazole, Tinidazole, Albendazole), antifungals (Fluconazole, Itraconazole), antihypertensives (Amlodipine, Telmisartan, Clopidogrel bisulphate), respiratory (Montelukast sodium, Ambroxol, Dextromethorphan HBr), plus Resveratrol, Glucosamine HCl, L-methyl folate, Serratiopeptidase, Benfotiamine, Allopurinol, Febuxostat, Strontium ranelate, Silodosin, Solifenacin succinate, Tolperisone HCl, Chlorzoxazone, Metadoxine. The Formulation page lists finished dosage categories: NSAIDs, cosmetic, Ayurvedic, antibiotics, vitamins, antidiabetic, CNS, antihypertensive, diuretics, gastro, allergic/fever, respiratory. The site also advertises in-licensing/out-licensing and 'exports of finished formulations' and a 'P2P business model' serving global pharma players.
comment: HS mapping: PARTIAL. The declared set 2933.49 / 2933.59 / 2933.99 / 2935.90 is a plausible but incomplete slice of the real catalogue. 2933.49 and 2933.99 are genuinely the core of the heterocyclic API basket (quinolone antibiotics, SERMs, PPIs, azoles, antiretrovirals, gabapentinoids) and 2933.59 covers pyrazolo-pyrimidine/pyrimidine items (Allopurinol, Teneligliptin-type). 2935.90 (sulphonamides) fits only Sulbactam sodium sterile - a single line out of 300+ products, so it is over-weighted in the declaration. Major declared-absent product lines: (a) finished formulations - the site explicitly sells 'exports of finished formulations' and lists 12 dosage-form categories, which belong in Chapter 30 (3004.90), not Chapter 29; (b) carboxamides/amides 2924.29 (Paracetamol, Nimesulide, Aceclofenac, Mefenamic acid, Etodolac, Glipizide, Gliclazide); (c) amino-acids/phenols 2922.49-2922.50 (Gabapentin, Phenylephrine HCl, Ambroxol); (d) pyridine heterocyclics 2933.39 (Amlodipine, Telmisartan, Dextromethorphan); (e) nucleic-acid derivatives 2934.99 (Sofosbuvir, Tenofovir, Valacyclovir, Valganciclovir); (f) antibiotics 2941.90 (Vancomycin, Rifaximin); (g) guanidines 2925.29 (Metformin); (h) vitamins 2936.2x (Benfotiamine); (i) oxygen-heterocycle 2932.99 (Resveratrol). Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a MISCLASSIFICATION: the company is a pharma API/formulation marketer, not an oil & gas or bulk-industrial-chemical supplier; the correct industry is pharmaceuticals/API. Trader signs are strong: the site describes in-licensing/out-licensing, a 'P2P business model', 'Orbit Impex' as the origin of the business, and 'exports of finished formulations' - i.e. a marketing/licensing intermediary rather than a demonstrated own-plant manufacturer; no manufacturing site or GMP certificate is named on the pages read. Per Rule 3 the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground: company is retained, code set should be corrected/expanded to at least 2933.49, 2933.39, 2933.59, 2933.99, 2934.99, 2941.90, 2924.29, 2922.49, 2925.29, 2936.29 and 3004.90. All product claims here are from the company's own website (orbitlifescience.com/products/api/ and /products/formulation/) and are therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' - no customs line, invoice or B-L was reviewed in this task, and no shipment records were checked (out of scope). Note: a similarly named US consulting firm at orbitlifesciences.com is a different, unrelated entity and was excluded. Revenue, export volume, CIN/PAN: null - not researched in this task.
